$comment: The authoritative source closure for the `@muse-code/sdk` publication.
Every path below is mirrored verbatim from this repository into the public
venue `meta-models/muse-code-sdk`, keeping its layout: a closure path
`clients/sdk-ts` here lands at `clients/sdk-ts` there, which is why the SDK
manifest's `repository.directory` is the same string on both sides. The
mirror's `publish-anchor.json` records which commit of this repository a
given republish carried, and names THIS file as its closure manifest.
This file is the producer-side authority: a republish reads it to decide
what to carry. It is not a digest, a count, or a copy of anything the tree
derives — it is the list itself, and `clients/sdk-ts/test/sdk-source-closure.test.ts`
checks that every path in it still exists and is still explained.

preserve_note: Prose, not a path list — the list itself deliberately lives on one side only.
The mirror holds hand-authored repository-meta files that have no upstream
counterpart — its README, LICENSE, .github/, .nojekyll and publish-anchor.json.
The authoritative list is `repo_meta.hand_authored` in the mirror's own
publish-anchor.json, not a second copy here. A republish that replaces the
tree wholesale deletes them silently and still reports success; preserve

path_notes.clients/msp-ts: The generated wire-types package the SDK compiles against. Private and never published on its own; it is in the closure so the mirror can build.
path_notes.clients/sdk-cookbook: The validated cookbook harness and its recipes. Published source: the docs site links readers straight at these programs.
path_notes.clients/sdk-quickstart: The quickstart journey a reader runs first. Published source, same reason as the cookbook.
path_notes.clients/sdk-ts: The SDK itself — the package `npm publish` ships, plus the QA harness and tests that prove it. Only `dist/src` reaches the tarball; the rest is closure source.
path_notes.package-lock.json: Pins the workspace install the mirror's `npm ci` performs. Without it a mirror build resolves different dependencies than this repository did.
path_notes.package.json: The workspace root. It declares the `clients/*` workspaces that make the mirrored tree installable as one unit.
path_notes.schema/msp/msp.d.ts: The generated MSP declarations the wire types re-export. The SDK tarball bundles a copy at publish time; the mirror needs the source.
path_notes.schema/msp/stable: The stable schema bundle the conformance oracle and the wire taps validate against.
path_notes.schema/msp/transcripts: The recorded wire transcripts the QA harness replays, so a mirror checkout can run the conformance arm offline.
path_notes.scripts/check-msp-ts-typecheck.sh: The typecheck gate `clients/msp-ts` runs, which resolves paths relative to the closure layout.
path_notes.scripts/publish-sdk-npm.sh: Every publish gate lives here, and the mirror's `publish-npm.yml` is a thin caller that invokes it by path. If a republish drops this file the publish workflow dead-ends before it reaches npm — the workflow says so in one line and names this manifest as the place it must be listed.
path_notes.scripts/sdk-source-closure.json: The closure carries its own definition: `clients/sdk-ts` is mirrored whole, including `test/sdk-source-closure.test.ts`, which reads this manifest at module load — a mirror without it crashes that guard with ENOENT before any arm runs.
